thread:
Priya: FYI my docs PR (#3591) hit the markdown-lint rules on the migration guide. Preview built but lint step failed with line-length and sentence-case on a subheading.
Omar: Can you paste the lint output? Might be two separate issues.
Priya: Sure, snippet from the logs:
```
markdown-lint: WARN migration-guide.md:120 - MD013/line-length: Line length (210/120)
markdown-lint: ERROR migration-guide.md:122 - SentenceCase: heading 'why redwood inference defaults to quantization' -> should be 'Why Redwood Inference defaults to quantization'
```
Maya: Long line is probably a long example command block that got inlined. If it's a code block we can mark it as fenced. For the sentence-case, we should prefer title casing in some product pages, but script enforces sentence case universally.
Priya: That heading is in a small FAQ so sentence case is fine. I can fix both. Question: for the long line, it's actually an inline cURL example we added; switching to a fenced block may change formatting on the preview. Thoughts?
Omar: Convert to a fenced code block and add a short caption line above it. That keeps the preview readable and satisfies MD013.
Priya: I'll push a tiny change. Also, lint-bot flagged a trailing whitespace rule elsewhere; will fix that too.
Priya: Pushing patch now (branch: pr-3591/docs-lint-fix). Diff:
```
- `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/... -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'`
+ Caption: Example request (fenced for lint)
+ ```bash
+ curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/... -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
+ ```
- ### why redwood inference defaults to quantization
+ ### Why Redwood Inference defaults to quantization
```
lint-bot: Preview deploy started for pr-3591  https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3591
infra-bot: Heads-up: preview runners do not mount repo-level dict for forks. Spellcheck may warn on product names (INFRA-PRIVACY).
Omar: Noted. If spellcheck warns for 'Redwood' we should add an inline ignore or add it to the doc's frontmatter dictionary for now.
Priya: No spell warnings this time, only lint passes/fails. Re-run CI triggered.
lint-bot: docs-lint: SUCCESS (fixes applied), docs-verify: running...
lint-bot: docs-verify: SUCCESS. Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3591
Maya: I can review after the preview is built. Priya, please request review from @Maya and @Omar once ready.
Priya: Requested. Omar/Maya, will you be able to approve in the 11:00-12:00 PST docs merge window?
Omar: I can approve quick if nothing else pops up.
Maya: Same here. Approving once I eyeball the preview for formatting.
Priya: Merged during the 11:15 slot. Backported the header fix to v1 branch too. Filing infra follow-up to improve fork preview spell handling (INFRA-2022). Thanks!
